content.text: The evidence clearly shows the feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` being rolled out starting at 15:32:00Z, coinciding exactly with the error rate spike, and a ZeroDivisionError in `spend_summary.py:47` — code that only executes when the flag is on. No code deployment or config change occurred; this is a flag toggle exposing a latent bug.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was rolled out (partial at 15:32, fully on by 15:33) and immediately triggered a ZeroDivisionError in spend_summary.py:47 on account pages, spiking the error rate from baseline (~1%) to 24-35%.
